name: export_carousel_pages
description: Export a carousel as web pages, in one new zip inside out (slides.zip, then slides 2.zip, ...; nothing already there is changed). Inside, one folder holds a still HTML page per slide (slide-01.html ...), plain HTML and CSS with no scripts, index.html, which swipes through them, and the images the slides use (assets/) with relative paths, so it opens anywhere once unzipped. Fonts load from Google Fonts the first time the pages open. With list true, writes nothing and lists the slides.

input.description: No file input: operates on a carousel project (see the project param).

output.description: {zip, pages: [slide-NN.html ...], index, files: [paths inside the zip's folder], warnings: [...]}; with list: {items: [{index, id}]}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: out
params.description: The folder to put the zip in (required unless list is true). Outside the workspace it must be an existing folder that is not hidden and not a system or app folder.

params.name: slides
params.description: Only these slides, as a comma-separated list of slide numbers from 1 (default: all)

params.name: list
params.description: List the slides and write nothing
